# Business Document Template

**Status:** FROZEN  
**Version:** 1.0  
**Change Policy:** ADR only

Use this template for all future business documents in RC2.

## Expected Structure

```text
<document-id>/
├── README.md
├── <document-id>_REQUIREMENTS.md
├── <document-id>_DESIGN.md
├── <document-id>_DB.md
├── <document-id>_API.md
├── <document-id>_IMPLEMENTATION.md
├── <document-id>_TEST_CASES.md
├── <document-id>_UAT.md
├── <document-id>_CHANGELOG.md
├── <document-id>_DECISIONS.md
├── <document-id>_KNOWN_ISSUES.md
└── <document-id>_CHECKLIST.md
```

## Standard Definition of Done
A business document is not done until the following are complete:
- Requirement
- Design
- Database
- API
- Implementation
- Workflow
- Finance
- Inventory
- Print
- Reports
- Dashboard
- Tests
- UAT
- Pilot
